name: New Born
query:
SELECT
    p.name AS "Baby PID:Link/Patient:120",
    p.patient_name AS "Baby Name:Data:220",
    p.mother_pid AS "Mother PID:Link/Patient:120",
    p.mother_name AS "Mother Name:Data:220"
FROM `tabPatient` p
WHERE
    IFNULL(p.is_new_born, 0) = 1
    AND IFNULL(p.mother_pid, '') != ''
    AND IFNULL(p.mother_name, '') != ''
ORDER BY p.name;
